task_title: Layer 10 grades the toolchain the repo kind needs, Go included
task_criteria: At the worker's own commit: bash tests/selftest.sh exits 0 (full battery, SELFTEST: PASS). scripts/project-node.sh layer 10 grades a Go toolchain for a Go-kind workspace: the go binary, its version read back, and one module resolved through the configured GOPROXY, with a named FAIL row when go is absent instead of a WARN. The graded set is derived from the repository kind actually present (go.mod -> go, Cargo.toml -> cargo, package.json -> node, pyproject.toml/setup.py -> python) or from an explicit kind declaration when no workspace exists yet, never from the fixed list alone. A fixture in tests/selftest.sh proves the same tree FAILS without go on PATH and PASSES with a stub go on PATH. specs/NODE.md's layer 10 cell names the derived set and the Go proxy probe, and the layer 00 cell's claim that no shipped layer measures a Go module proxy is corrected in the same change.
